request:
덕테이프 포스터로 동네 생활수리 워크숍을 홍보해줘. SNS와 지역 커뮤니티에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 다섯 장은 전체 스타일과 구도가 서로 달랐으면 좋겠어. 의자나 옷을 함께 고치는 경험이 시각적으로 느껴져야 하고, 설명부터 일정·장소·비용·신청 안내까지 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 본문을 작게 구석에 밀어 넣지 말아줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목·정보 블록에 작은 그림만 붙인 구성, 빈 방을 글자판으로 쓴 구성은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 아래 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

고쳐 쓰는 토요일
REPAIR / TOGETHER
버리는 대신, 함께 고칩니다.
헐거워진 의자와 찢어진 옷을 가져오세요. 이웃 수리자와 도구를 나누며 다시 쓰는 방법을 배웁니다.
마포 생활수리 워크숍
2027.05.22
토요일 14:00–18:00
합정 동네작업실
참가비 5,000원 · 도구 제공
신청 마감 5월 18일
수리할 물건 한 가지를 가져오세요.
repair.example/join

copy.text: 헐거워진 의자와 찢어진 옷을 가져오세요. 이웃 수리자와 도구를 나누며 다시 쓰는 방법을 배웁니다.

directions.name: 행동의 연속과 중앙 문장
directions.organization: A horizontal sequence of three tightly edited real repair moments runs across the upper half. The lower region is a strongly connected invitation with two substantial description lines then aligned event and participation groups; a modest title bridges the sequence and body rather than a giant title at one end.
directions.concept: People share tools: fastening a chair joint, sewing a garment and handing a restored useful thing to a neighbor. Cropped real hands and worn objects express cooperation, not a decorative hero object.
directions.image_grammar: Documentary color photographs with crisp contact geometry and close crop, three different scales tied by the direction of hands. Restrained cobalt/brick accents from actual tools and fabric, daylight skin/wood. The image sequence and its crop dominate the overall structure.
directions.body_flow: The middle handoff invites the central title, then the full meaning paragraph below, then adjacent event/date/time/place and fee/deadline/item/URL blocks aligned with that paragraph. Choose substantial mature body at a 720px viewing assumption, reserve its actual sentence area first. Reading does not jump to remote corners.
directions.type: Dense but precise editorial Korean sans body, mature compact counters and robust medium strokes, Latin optically matched. Title can be a moderate serif; body remains upright clean print.
directions.distinctness: Across-the-width multiple photo moments with copy beneath their seam; no giant left object and right information, no surrounding collage or center narrative ink path.

directions.name: 연결된 수리 지도
directions.organization: Top-down image graph spreads through the whole landscape field. Two material transformations, a chair joint and a patched garment, meet through shared physical tools; substantial real-copy groups occupy connected openings inside that graph.
directions.concept: One neighbor holds a tightening clamp, another guides a needle through a real fabric tear. Tools and repairs form a purposeful connected planar system, with no fake diagram dimensions or instruction captions.
directions.image_grammar: Precisely cut matte paper shapes, photographic wood grain and textile fibers with clean shared edges. A rust/claret/charcoal and natural cotton palette; the paper is shaped to actual repair relationships, not a passive color field with a tiny illustration. No giant outlined heading or toy clay.
directions.body_flow: Short title near the shared tool junction; full description contiguous near the stitch-to-joint connection. Event/date/time/place grouped beside the relevant open shape, fee/deadline/item/URL grouped as an adjoining next stop connected through the graph edge. Body is perfectly flat upright mature print, not woven lettering or labels on tiny tools. Budget readable sentence area at 720px before objects.
directions.type: Mature Korean low-contrast serif body with moderate optical weight and uniform glyph anatomy; event numerals clear, title compact contemporary sans.
directions.distinctness: A distributed top-down material network with embedded contiguous copy, rather than a photographic horizontal strip, a single continuous human scene, a sequential comic page or a repaired-object montage.

directions.name: 같은 테이블의 공간
directions.organization: One continuous oblique table scene spans the full width and depth. Two neighbors repairing chair and garment anchor opposite ends; the open table between real activities supports a connected plane of overlaid flat typesetting, with no separate right text column.
directions.concept: Cooperation is a visible exchange of a real screwdriver and fabric across a busy neighborhood table. Two people shown with believable working postures, repaired objects grounded in real contact.
directions.image_grammar: Painterly gouache with bold precise silhouettes, nuanced warm coral, deep aubergine and light yellow-green color relationships. Active table objects, human interaction and table edges structure the whole field. Not an empty studio wall; not glossy clay.
directions.body_flow: Title follows the table opening centrally, description in a broad connected paragraph immediately below it, event/date/time/place and participation group next to one another along the same table-directed reading axis. Enough open image area is designed for large clean upright body; copy floats in a flat graphic plane, never foreshortened on the physical table.
directions.type: Precisely printed mature Korean sans with open counters, low stroke contrast, stable widths. Title expressive but not oversized; small copy no brush texture.
directions.distinctness: A single continuous human scene with center-integrated copy and a depth-directed reading axis; no strip sequence, graph network, framed comic modules or cut-image comparison.

directions.name: 수선의 작은 서사
directions.organization: Several unequal illustrated episodes form an irregular narrative across the width. A strong lower-center description anchors them, while event and participation are clearly grouped immediately adjacent; no regular five-card grid or equal labels in all corners.
directions.concept: A wobbly chair and torn shirt become useful through several specific neighbor gestures. Illustrate the changing state without new numbered instructions or invented slogans.
directions.image_grammar: Confident brush-and-ink editorial drawing with deliberate saturated red-orange, blue-black and pale lavender areas. Distinct silhouettes and a clear patch/stitch/joint logic; visible intentional line variation in images, perfectly precise type. The episodes form a broad asymmetric rhythm, not one enormous mascot.
directions.body_flow: The existing headline enters among the repaired-result episode, then long explanation is a single continuous robust paragraph adjoining the narrative opening. The event and participation groups follow through shared beginnings and spacing. No callout text invented and no sentence split across episodes. Body readable at720, clean front-plane print.
directions.type: Substantial precise Korean serif body with restrained contrast, consistent counters/baselines, Latin and numbers balanced; headline sturdy hand-ink character only if all original Korean is fully mature and exact.
directions.distinctness: Unequal drawn narrative episodes with one strong central paragraph, not the graph network, a continuous table scene, photographic strip or enlarged object crop.

directions.name: 복구된 경계의 편집
directions.organization: Two unequal large close-up crops of repaired wood and sewn textile meet in an interlocking edge spanning the poster, with a smaller context cutout of actual shared work. The real copy occupies one broad upright opening shaped by that joint, not left hero/right stacked copy.
directions.concept: The repaired joint and stitched fabric show value in keeping everyday things; one concrete shared gesture ties these material details to community repair.
directions.image_grammar: High-detail photographic material crops edited with hard confident boundaries and limited ultramarine/acid-yellow flat accents at real intersections. Warm worn wood, contrasting seam and tactile garment, no fake embossed typography or arbitrary chromed object.
directions.body_flow: Title interacts with the interlocking edge at moderate scale. Full description follows immediately along the same opening; event/date/time/place and fee/deadline/item/URL have stable optically aligned starts in adjacent functional groups. Broad body area and robust upright letters established at720 display before enlarging the crops. No tiny isolated captions or corner URL.
directions.type: Carefully typeset contemporary Korean sans body with slightly wide mature forms, stable medium-weight strokes, balanced Latin/numerals; title a tighter contrasting typographic voice.
directions.distinctness: Interlocking unequal enlarged material boundaries and contextual cutout; not a top-down tool network, ordered photo strip, continuous depicted room/table or illustrated episode structure.

common_constraints: Resolve the actual whole structure and readable body area first; material names are subordinate to that design.
Use the already-collected design idea library; no fresh browsing, no source re-opening or source paperwork. No source raster is a client asset.
Each native prompt prints the full required copy once, chosen positive visual relationships and relevant conditions; no rubric or JSON dump.

720px-wide social/community display is a coordinator design assumption, not a new client-fixed pixel/font/layout requirement. Mature body typically14–18px at that display implies ample paragraph area, not tiny footer print.
Coordinator relationships are design guidance; actual successful distinct relationships may vary without repairs to match coordinates.
Do not inspect peers or external critic feedback; preserve every initial and bounded repair and close own selection first.
source_role: ROOT draws on learned whole-composition principles, no mandatory new research.
